content.text: Travel vaccinesGet the vaccines you need to stay healthy abroad. Call 800-789-7366Travel immunizations from Penn MedicineGetting the proper vaccinations before you travel outside the country is crucial. Vaccines protect you from diseases that aren’t common in the U.S., such as yellow fever and Japanese encephalitis. At Penn Medicine, we offer all the vaccines you need to stay healthy on an international trip. We recommend setting up an appointment for a consultation as soon as you know where you’re traveling, ideally six to eight weeks before your trip. Some vaccines are given in a series, and you’ll need time to complete the series to develop full immunity. Once you’re vaccinated, we give you an official immunization record that you can keep with your travel documents.Determining the travel vaccines you needOur travel medicine experts consider several factors when recommending travel vaccines, such as your: Destination Age Health history Previous vaccination record Travel vaccines we provide We offer a number of travel immunizations, including: Cholera Hepatitis A Hepatitis B Influenza Japanese Encephalitis Measles Meningitis Polio Rabies Shingles Tetanus/Diphtheria/Pertussis (Tdap) Typhoid Varicella Yellow fever Schedule an appointmentWe can help you schedule an appointment or you can search our directory of specialists.Make an appointmentCall 800-789-7366Manage Your Cookie SettingsYour PrivacyStrictly Necessary CookiesPerformance CookiesFunctional CookiesTargeting CookiesYour PrivacyPenn Medicine websites, including Pennmedicine.org, Lancastergeneralhealth.org, Chestercountyhospital.org, and Princetonhcs.org use cookies and other tracking technologies to collect data and improve your experience.
